title: {settlement} is failing
A town in need
summary: {settlement} is in decline — trade dries up and folk are leaving. {giver} asks those who can to give to the treasury.
offer: You have seen the empty houses. The mine gave out and trade went with it; families leave every week. Give what you can to the treasury, and we may yet hold on until better days.
complete: You have done more for this town than you know. We will not forget it.
